# AIHOT selective reuse

Upstream: https://github.com/KKKKhazix/AIHOT
Pinned commit: `589f79eff09470b31ba8a7f1d9eb62d36ff2be6c`.
Copyright (c) 2026 数字生命卡兹克. MIT; see `../../licenses/AIHOT-LICENSE.txt`.

`algorithms.ts` contains selected code from `events/relate.ts` and `sources/json-list.ts`, with string identifiers, prototype-key rejection and reduced framework dependencies. Two-score selection and participant/time decay are adapted from the upstream selection and heat algorithms. They are actually imported by the intelligence domain and pipeline; this is not an unused vendor archive.

The host-owned collectors, durable jobs/receipts, construction ontology, source handoff and calibration module adapt architectural mechanisms; they are not claimed to be verbatim copies of AIHOT's PostgreSQL/pg-boss implementation. The existing DSH transport, original-page extraction, canonical Source, database connection and Python BM25 remain authoritative.

No AIHOT name/logo, fonts, production source list, model leaderboard, social-provider credentials or operational data are included. The source list in this project consists of existing construction-source catalogue templates, disabled and unverified until explicitly collected.

Static inventory and hashes: `../../research/aihot.upstream.lock.json`.
